# GENERATED FILE: edit tools/leadership_templates and run tools/gen_runtime.py.
# Character ROOT. Declaration is a political claim; the native legitimate HoF binding is not changed.
# If a native head already exists, register a separately owned challenger office using the real 1.20 API.
lyd_c3_declare_claim_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = lyd_c3_claim_title } NOT = { has_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant } }
        set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_claim_faith value = faith }
        set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_claim_rite value = rite }
        add_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant
        if = {
            limit = { lyd_c3_native_challenger_admitted_trigger = yes lyd_c3_native_challenger_eligible_trigger = yes }
            save_scope_as = lyd_c3_claimant
            faith = { save_scope_as = my_faith save_scope_as = lyd_c3_claim_faith }
            rite = { save_scope_as = lyd_c3_claim_rite }
            create_dynamic_title = { tier = duchy name = lyd_c3_claim_title_name adj = lyd_c3_claim_title_adj }
            scope:new_title = {
                set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_owned_claim_title value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_owner_faith value = scope:lyd_c3_claim_faith }
                set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_owner_rite value = scope:lyd_c3_claim_rite }
                set_landless_title = yes
                set_destroy_if_invalid_heir = yes
                set_no_automatic_claims = yes
                set_definitive_form = yes
                set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
                set_capital_county = scope:lyd_c3_claimant.capital_county
            }
            create_title_and_vassal_change = { type = created save_scope_as = lyd_c3_claim_change add_claim_on_loss = no }
            scope:new_title = { change_title_holder = { holder = scope:lyd_c3_claimant change = scope:lyd_c3_claim_change } }
            resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:lyd_c3_claim_change
            scope:new_title = { generate_coa = religious_title sponsor_new_religious_head_challenger = scope:new_title }
            set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_claim_title value = scope:new_title }
            debug_log = "LYD_C3_NATIVE_CHALLENGER_REGISTERED"
        }
        else = { debug_log = "LYD_C3_POLITICAL_CLAIM_WITHOUT_NATIVE_OFFICE" }
    }
}
# Character ROOT. Remove only its exact owned challenger office; never touch a foreign title or the real HoF.
lyd_c3_withdraw_claim_effect = {
    save_scope_as = lyd_c3_withdrawing_claimant
    var:lyd_c3_claim_sponsor ?= { remove_list_variable = { name = lyd_c3_sponsored_claims target = scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_claimant } }
    var:lyd_c3_claim_title ?= {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:lyd_c3_owned_claim_title = 1
                holder ?= scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_claimant
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_claimant.faith.religious_head_title }
                    NOT = { this = scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_claimant.faith.religious_head_title }
                }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { exists = var:lyd_c3_owner_faith.religious_head_title }
                    NOT = { this = var:lyd_c3_owner_faith.religious_head_title }
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = lyd_c3_withdrawing_office
            var:lyd_c3_owner_faith ?= {
                save_scope_as = lyd_c3_old_claim_faith
                every_religious_head_challenger = {
                    limit = { this = scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_office }
                    scope:lyd_c3_old_claim_faith = { remove_religious_head_challenger = scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_office }
                }
            }
            scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_claimant = { destroy_title = scope:lyd_c3_withdrawing_office }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = lyd_c3_claim_title
    remove_variable = lyd_c3_claim_faith
    remove_variable = lyd_c3_claim_rite
    remove_variable = lyd_c3_claim_sponsor
    remove_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant
    debug_log = "LYD_C3_CLAIM_WITHDRAWN"
}
# A PLAYER may nominate several consenting NPC political claimants. This bounded
# response does NOT grant them a native challenger office or the legitimate HoF.
lyd_c3_nomination_accepted_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:actor = { lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes var:lyd_c3_nominated_claimant = scope:recipient }
            scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes faith = scope:actor.faith NOT = { has_trait = incapable } learning >= 12 NOT = { has_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant } }
            scope:actor != scope:recipient
        }
        scope:recipient = {
            set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_claim_faith value = faith }
            set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_claim_rite value = rite }
            set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_claim_sponsor value = scope:actor }
            add_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant
        }
        scope:actor = {
            add_to_variable_list = { name = lyd_c3_sponsored_claims target = scope:recipient }
            remove_variable = lyd_c3_nominated_claimant
        }
        debug_log = "LYD_C3_NPC_POLITICAL_CLAIM_CONSENTED"
    }
}
lyd_c3_nominated_withdrawal_accepted_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:actor = { lyd_c3_player_actor_trigger = yes }
            scope:recipient = { is_alive = yes has_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant var:lyd_c3_claim_sponsor = scope:actor }
        }
        scope:recipient = { lyd_c3_withdraw_claim_effect = yes }
    }
}
# Rite ROOT; add this AFTER I2's existing pre-migration hook and BEFORE the native setter.
# Existing I2 dependency snapshots stay intact; this companion also removes owned native claim offices.
lyd_c3_cleanup_rite_claim_offices_effect = {
    save_scope_as = lyd_c3_cleaning_rite
    faith = {
        every_faith_character = {
            limit = {
                rite = scope:lyd_c3_cleaning_rite
                OR = {
                    has_variable = lyd_c3_claim_sponsor
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = lyd_c3_claim_title
                        var:lyd_c3_claim_title = { var:lyd_c3_owned_claim_title = 1 var:lyd_c3_owner_rite = scope:lyd_c3_cleaning_rite }
                    }
                }
            }
            lyd_c3_withdraw_claim_effect = yes
        }
    }
}
